Roblox Company Research 

Roblox builds a platform for creating, participating in, and hosting video game experiences with the global community. For this application, I want to emphasize engineering work that makes those experiences responsive and gives creators useful tools. The summer 2027 internship offers a twelve-week project with mentorship and responsibility through implementation, testing, deployment, and presentation. That makes my production software work and interactive projects a useful combination to emphasize. [1] 

Page Break
 

1

In my research, I found Andrew Swerdlow's February 2025 article, which explains how Roblox supports engineers with tools for deploying services, reviewing code, and understanding software behavior. It describes automated canary analysis, which checks a limited release before a change reaches more users. This is similar to my work on model evaluations at Phoebe. Both involve finding evidence of problems before proceeding with a change. In the letter, I will connect that approach to my changes to the v3 agent harness at Phoebe and how I rolled out those changes, without implying that I have already built Roblox's release systems.
